name: Azariah
bio: Azariah the priest, along with eighty other priests of the LORD, confronted King Uzziah of Judah when he entered the temple to burn incense on the altar, a duty reserved for Aaron's consecrated priests alone. He warned Uzziah that this trespass would bring him no honor from the LORD; as Uzziah raged at the priests, leprosy broke out on his forehead on the spot, and Azariah and the priests hurried the stricken king out of the temple (2 Chronicles 26:17-20). He is a different figure from King Uzziah, also called Azariah, whom he confronted.
